description: Use when you need email validation, to verify email addresses or validate email syntax and MX records before sending or signup. Do not use for confirming that the mailbox itself exists (no SMTP probe is done) or sending email. Returns JSON with email verification of one address: syntax, domain MX records, disposable, free and role-account flags, SPF and DMARC, and a verdict on whether the domain can receive mail for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 800 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).
